## Standing operator rules
- Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.
- Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.
- Staging exports now go to ledgerly-exports-stg-v2. The old ledgerly-exports-stg bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.
- Run the separate “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” procedure one step at a time.

## Current objective
Annotate the untyped helpers in `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`. The earlier dunning scheduler fix is paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Current staging exports bucket: `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; `ledgerly-exports-stg` is superseded and must not be written to.
- Python support: 3.9+.
- Webhook cutover snapshot: `webhook_cutover_20250308`; backup table: `webhook_cursors`.
- `WebhookSender.max_attempts: int = 3`.
- Search indexing baseline: 247 passed, 4 skipped; the former 18-passed/2-failed baseline is superseded.
- Search rebuild: `CHUNK_SIZE = 100`, up to 8 embedding workers, tenant-scoped invoice scans, and unique `search_vectors_tenant_document_idx` on `(tenant_id, document_id)`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Retrying every `HTTPStatusError`: 4xx errors such as 422 must fail immediately.
- Direct webhook delivery without retries: superseded by bounded transport/retryable-server retries.
- Raising Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours: duplicate jobs remained invisible for hours.

## Recent work
CSV report writing was changed to explicit UTF-8 with regression coverage for `Zoë,東京`; Ruff, `git diff --check`, exporter tests (24 passed), and the full suite (186 passed, 3 skipped) passed. Webhook cutover steps 2 and 3 succeeded: v2 health was healthy and deployment image `v2.8.1` was set. Invoice annotation work started after 12 baseline tests passed; `invoices.py` now imports `Decimal`, `Iterable`, and `TypedDict`, and `LineItem` has been annotated.
